subject.title: fix(cron): allow timeoutSeconds: 0 for no-timeout mode

question: Should the Control UI expose the gateway-supported `timeoutSeconds: 0` no-timeout sentinel, and if so should this stale conflicting branch be refreshed or replaced?
rationale: The backend contract already supports zero, but exposing it in the UI removes the cron wall-clock safety timeout for user-created jobs and this branch is stale and proof-gated.

options.title: Refresh and prove the UI fix
options.body: Update the fix onto `ui/src/lib/cron/index.ts`, add regression coverage, and require redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the UI positive-only
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged if maintainers do not want ordinary Control UI users to create no-timeout cron jobs.

options.title: Replace the stale branch
options.body: Open or sponsor a current-main replacement and close this PR only after the replacement owns the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Refresh and prove the UI fix
recommendation.body: Update the fix onto `ui/src/lib/cron/index.ts`, add regression coverage, and require redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame routes the active cron UI module through `vincentkoc`'s current-path carrier commit, making this the best available owner for the moved-code refresh decision.
